'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Kevin Shannon DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Kevin Shannon]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2).

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 2
